# gitmoap_group_packages (Data Source)

List a group's packages. Returns the packages in the group's npm, Cargo and PyPI registries, each with its newest version, version count and total size. Name a `format` (npm, cargo or pypi) to page through one registry with `limit` (up to 100, 20 by default) and `cursor`; without one you get an overview of up to 100 packages per format and no further pages. `search` keeps only the packages whose name contains it, ignoring case, before a page is cut — so an empty page means there is no match, not that the match is further on; send it again with the cursor. Anyone who can see the group may call it.

The token needs `package:read`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gitmoap_group_by_path" "acme" {
  full_path = "acme"
}

data "gitmoap_group_packages" "acme" {
  group_id = data.gitmoap_group_by_path.acme.group_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (String) Owning group id

### Optional

- `format` (String) Filter by format (npm/cargo/pypi)
- `search` (String) Only packages whose name contains this, ignoring case (1-200 characters)

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `format` (String) The package ecosystem a registry speaks. A group has at most one registry per format.
- `latest_version` (String) The newest version, when there is one.
- `name` (String) The package's name, as it was published.
- `total_bytes` (Number) The size of every file of every version, in bytes.
- `updated_at` (String)
- `version_count` (Number)
